budget_philosophy.rule: Soft priors, never hard filters. The judge weighs price against how RIGHT the piece is - a perfect item over the prior still gets shown, flagged as a splurge.

taste_signals.source: Extracted from detailed viewing of ALL 50 Pinterest Clothes corpus images (36 on 2026-07-07, the remaining 14 on 2026-08-07). Full extraction: taste/taste-profile.md. Votes in taste/votes.json override everything here. NOTE: roughly 1 in 8 corpus images is a mood/photography/hair pin with no garment focus - do not read product signal out of those.
style_read: vintage-leaning relaxed streetwear on earthy neutrals - washed workwear + chunky knits over baggy light denim / carpenter / cargo pants
EVERYTHING relaxed-to-baggy; zero slim fits on the board - a slim version of the right item is the wrong item
layering formula: white tee/tank base -> open chore jacket / overshirt / flannel -> optional varsity or field jacket
denim is always light-wash or heavily faded; one loud accent piece per outfit max against a muted base
thrift/vintage finish beats box-fresh: washed, faded, worn-in textures score up; raw/frayed/cut hems and blown-out knees are wanted, not merely tolerated
silver jewelry near-constant (rings, chains); canvas totes; round wire glasses; textured medium-length hair references

the dressed-up end is WIDE PLEATED TROUSERS in greige/grey wool with an oversized crew and white AF1s - never slim tailoring. This is the corporate-presentable answer the board actually gives (2026-08-07 pass)
reference_brands_liked: Nike retro (AF1 white = most-worn shoe on the board by a wide margin; Dunk Low AND Dunk High; Jordan 1 high; Jordan 4)
Converse Chuck 70 specifically, cream/egret foxing preferred
colors_avoid: dark rigid denim (appears once across the whole board)
no_gos_inferred_confirm_via_votes: SLIM tailoring and suiting - but NOT dressy fabric per se: wide pleated greige/grey-wool trousers are on the board and score well, so do not reject a trouser for being dressy, only for being slim
chunky-tech dad shoes (except tonal Yeezy-700 case)
soft_rules_not_filters: silver jewelry is ~95% of the board but one gold chain appears (image 49), so treat silver as a strong preference, not a hard filter

context.climate: Salt Lake City area - four seasons, dry, cold winters

avoid: marketplace third-party sellers at inflated prices
